description: Imports a Word document as a Polarion LiveDoc, creating or updating document content according to the request options. Requires project and space access plus a valid Word file; use `postDocuments` to create a LiveDoc from JSON:API data or `importExcelTestResults` for test-result spreadsheets. Effect: triggers a server-side action rather than a plain resource creation — whether repeating it is safe, a no-op, or rejected depends on the specific action; treat it as not guaranteed idempotent. Tip: set `dry_run: true` first to validate the arguments and preview the exact request without sending it to Polarion. The executor returns this preview as normal text, and as structured content when the tool declares an output schema.

dry_run.description: If true, validates the request and returns the exact request that would be sent to Polarion — with the Authorization header redacted and any binary payload summarized by byte length — without actually sending it.

projectId.description: The Polarion project ID (its URL segment, e.g. `myproject`), case-sensitive. Required to scope the request to one project. If the ID is unknown, ask the user; getProjects lists IDs only with global read access.

requestBody.description: Multipart form data with 'file' (binary .docx) and 'parameters' (JSON object with documentName, title, documentType, and optional configurationId).

spaceId.description: The Document Space ID (a folder-like grouping of documents/pages within a project). Use `_default` (no quotes) to address the project's default space.

name: importWordDocument
